ModMetaData.name: Categorized Cleaning - Split
ModMetaData.author: PeteTimesSix
ModMetaData.description:
Splits the cleaning work type into three columns you can prioritize separately:
One for clean rooms (kitchens, hospitals and laboratories) One for indoor cleaning One for outdoor cleaning in the home area (body fluids and debris only, by default)
A "Cleaning" tab at the bottom of the screen lists every room and cleaning zone on the map in five lanes: clean rooms, interior, exterior, ignored, and custom. Rooms are placed automatically by type (bedrooms are named after their owners) and can be moved between lanes. Custom entries choose their own filth kinds, which work column cleans them, and extra upkeep such as cutting grass, clearing snow or hauling debris. Cleaning zones are drawn with Architect > Zone. The mod settings hold the defaults: which room types land where, and which filth kinds each lane cleans.
